---
name: Feature Request
description: Propose a new feature or enhancement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem or gap. Use the form
_"As a [role], I want [capability], so that [benefit]."_

## Proposed Solution

Describe the desired behaviour and how it would work. Mock-ups, ASCII
diagrams, and example API calls are all welcome.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you weighed, and why this one is better.

## Impact

- **Users affected**: who benefits?
- **Breaking change?**: yes / no
- **Effort estimate**: small / medium / large
- **Affected components**: `backend`, `frontend`, `sdk/python`, `sdk/typescript`, `infra`, `docs`

## Alternatives

- [ ] I am willing to submit a PR implementing this feature
- [ ] I would prefer to discuss the design first in GitHub Discussions

## Additional Context

Links, screenshots, related issues, prior art from other projects.
